subject_line: Fix zizmor error[cache-poisoning]: runtime artifacts potentially vulnerable to a cache poisoning attack
s1_reason: CI workflow hardening ('cache' is a CI cache)

subject_line: Fix memory leak parsing large integers
s1_reason: PyObject_Malloc buffer in Object_newIntegerFromString was never freed (JSONtoObj.c)
s2_reason: one leaked buffer per integer literal outside the C integer range
s3_reason: newIntegerFromString is only called when the decoder's 64-bit accumulation overflows (ultrajsondec.c decode_numeric: n > 2^64-1 or n < -2^63); the frozen grammar caps integers at |n| <= 2^53-1 (json.fan deviation 8, I-JSON). Would be visible as rss_growth over K_PARSE loads if the grammar allowed big integers
notes: via: keyword + release note 5.12.0 (links the commit); first release 5.12.0 (2026-03-11, before: 5.11.0 2025-08-20); in existing pool

subject_line: Fix encoding ref leak with non-English character (#714)
s1_reason: bytes object from PyUnicode_AsEncodedString leaked per non-ASCII string on the encoder path (objToJSON.c PyUnicodeToUTF8Raw)
s2_reason: one leak per non-ASCII string encoded
s3_reason: encoder (ujson.dumps) only; json subject times loads only (subjects/json/user_systems.py, K_PARSE=3000 loads per call); dumps is never called. Would be visible as rss_growth in a dumps-timing subject
notes: via: keyword + release note 5.12.1; first release 5.12.1 (2026-05-05); in existing pool
